summary: Core University Living Real Estate Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting the completed acquisition of a four-property student housing portfolio (Seed Portfolio) for $303.5 million, funded by a $180.4 million mortgage loan from JPMorgan and share sale proceeds. The seller was a joint venture between a third party and entities owned by principals of sponsor Core Spaces. The portfolio was 99.4% pre-leased for the 2026-2027 academic year. The loan bears interest at Term SOFR plus 1.50%, matures July 22, 2029, with two one-year extensions subject to DSCR and LTV tests. Watch for integration execution and debt-service coverage.
